verdict.rationale: Muse's docs claim it can complete real-world web-based tasks like planning/booking trips, negotiating bills, selling a car, and checking out via Stripe Link, implying it interacts with websites and services on the user's behalf, and it can build custom connectors/tools when needed. However, there is no explicit description of a browser-automation mechanism, and the only independent evidence (muse-comm-1, muse-comm-2) discusses agent control-plane failures under stress and skepticism about unsophisticated users' ability to leverage it, not confirmation of successful web-browsing task completion. Missing for 10: explicit description of browser control/automation, independent hands-on confirmation of successful website task completion.
